purpose: Compact provenance and source-scope index. The author interpretations below are not independent experimental evidence.

source_preservation.alternative_products: Absent in the genuine seed; not manufactured.
source_preservation.scope: Historical 609-residue NOT3 cDNA and 753-residue NOT3L names are not treated as current curated alternative products. Modern studies distinguish N-terminal recognition from C-terminal assembly constructs.

PMID:10637334.scope: Human NOT3 associates with CALIF/CNOT8 in two-hybrid and endogenous coimmunoprecipitation assays.
PMID:10637334.access: The initial CNOT3 normal output was abstract-only and remains archived. The selected source is the authenticated genuine full variant fetched for CNOT1; selected original Methods and Results were read. The historical cloned NOT3 is 609 residues and is not equated with the current 753-residue product; endogenous association is separately positive.

external_full_variant.origin: Authenticated shared genuine normal full selected after archiving the original absent-main abstract.

PMID:12207886.scope: TIP120B/CAND2 binds the extended NOT3L form through mapped partner regions in pull-down and two-hybrid assays.
PMID:12207886.access: Complete authentic abstract read. Full original construct details remain unavailable; mouse myogenic expression and the two source participant accessions are retained without inventing an exact species assignment for every construct.

PMID:16189514.scope: The human interaction screen contains a positive CNOT3–CNOT2 two-hybrid-pooling record.
PMID:16189514.access: Complete authentic abstract and exact positive IntAct record inspected. Original full experimental detail was not recovered; the specific heterodimer refinement is supported independently by PMID:24121232.

PMID:16778766.scope: Human CNOT3 coimmunoprecipitates with CCR4–NOT subunits, and depletion changes estrogen-responsive transcript output in MCF7 cells.
PMID:16778766.access: Selected complete Methods and Results read. CNOT1 is the directly characterized nuclear-receptor-binding subunit; CNOT3 association and depletion effects are not recast as direct receptor or DNA binding.

PMID:17452450.scope: Human CNOT6 and CNOT6L pull-downs recover CNOT3, with reciprocal tagged CNOT3 corroboration for CNOT6L.
PMID:17452450.access: Selected full Methods and Results read. Human expression experiments and mouse endogenous coimmunoprecipitation are distinguished; the nuclease activity belongs to the catalytic partners.

PMID:18377426.scope: Tagged Tob and Cnot3 coimmunoprecipitate in the original mammalian complex study.
PMID:18377426.access: The selected protected cache is abstract-only; selected Methods and Results were read from the separately archived genuine normal full variant. Deadenylation of an immunoprecipitated assembly is not evidence of CNOT3 catalysis.

external_full_variant.origin: Genuine normal publication fetch, archived separately from protected selected abstract.

PMID:19558367.scope: Human CCR4–NOT complexes have a stable core including CNOT3 and alternative catalytic deadenylase subunits.
PMID:19558367.access: The complete authentic abstract was read. An author-uploaded full-paper record was authenticated, but follow-up indexed text retrieval did not yield the original Methods used here; no full-paper read is claimed. Independent human structural and recombinant sources establish the core refinement.

PMID:20211142.scope: A systematic mammalian two-hybrid study supports the CNOT3–CNOT2 association.
PMID:20211142.access: The protected cache remains abstract-only; actual Methods were read from a genuine fresh full variant. They describe CHO-K1 reporter assays, self-activation screening and pair retesting; the literal curated records retain their original assay vocabulary.

external_full_variant.origin: Genuine normal publication fetch, archived separately from protected selected abstract.

PMID:21981923.scope: GW182 recruits deadenylase complexes, with direct NOT1 and PAN3 contacts described in the abstract.
PMID:21981923.access: Complete authentic abstract read; full target-pair assay scope remains unavailable. The curated CNOT3 association is retained at complex scope without asserting a directly mapped TNRC6C–CNOT3 interface.

PMID:21984185.scope: Human GW182 motifs recruit CCR4–NOT during miRNA-mediated deadenylation.
PMID:21984185.access: Complete authentic abstract read; exact CNOT3 and CNOT2 pair-specific full experiments remain uninspected. Positive curated associations are retained, with the CNOT2 heterodimer refined using independent structural evidence.

PMID:22367759.scope: Mouse and human embryonic stem cells require CNOT3 to maintain self-renewal and restrain extraembryonic differentiation.
PMID:22367759.access: Selected complete Methods and Results read, including mouse knockdown/rescue and human H1/H9 depletion. Cell-state regulation does not establish a CNOT3-specific DNA-binding activity or direct participation in every induced lineage program.

PMID:24736845.scope: All three human NANOS proteins associate with CCR4–NOT, while their interaction motifs bind CNOT1 rather than the isolated CNOT2–CNOT3 module.
PMID:24736845.access: Selected original Methods and Results read. Positive CNOT3 pull-down association is preserved, and direct motif recognition is assigned to the experimentally resolved subunit.

PMID:26496610.scope: Quantitative human interaction profiling detects CNOT3 associations with CNOT1 and CNOT2.
PMID:26496610.access: Complete authentic abstract and exact anti-tag coimmunoprecipitation records inspected. Native-complex association is not presented as proof of a purified binary interface; the CNOT2 structural relationship has independent evidence.

PMID:28032897.scope: Adipocyte-specific mouse Cnot3 loss reduces brown-fat Ucp1 and cold tolerance in the context of lipodystrophy.
PMID:28032897.access: The selected normal cache is abstract-only. Authentic Wiley full-text Methods, Results and Discussion were read externally, including the 4 °C challenge and baseline controls. The precise immediate causal path from RNA regulation to thermogenesis remains unresolved.

PMID:28514442.scope: BioPlex affinity purification detects the TOB1–CNOT3 association.
PMID:28514442.access: Selected original assay context and the exact tagged-bait/prey record were inspected. The screen supports association, not a pair-specific catalytic or adaptor mechanism.

PMID:31320642.scope: The human noncatalytic NOT module helps stimulate CCR4–NOT deadenylation.
PMID:31320642.access: Selected complete Methods, Results and Discussion read. The tested C-terminal CNOT3 constructs include residues 607–753 or 607–748. Lack of RNA binding by that isolated module does not contradict later N-terminal ribosome/tRNA recognition.

PMID:31515488.scope: The CNOT3–CNOT2 interaction is positive in a variant-focused two-hybrid study.
PMID:31515488.access: Selected complete two-hybrid Methods and exact IntAct record read. The recorded position-491 CNOT3 variant is marked as having no effect on this interaction; no loss-of-binding claim is made.

PMID:31570513.scope: HELZ C-terminal segments bind the CCR4–NOT NOT module and promote decay of tethered transcripts.
PMID:31570513.access: Selected full human Methods and Results read, including purified NOT1–NOT2–NOT3 module binding. These experiments do not assign the sole HELZ-contact site to CNOT3; HELZ is a superfamily-1 helicase, not a DEAD/H-box protein.

PMID:32296183.scope: HuRI provides positive binary CNOT3–CNOT2 interaction records.
PMID:32296183.access: Actual Results and assay/validation descriptions plus three literal curated records were read. Global orthogonal validation does not establish that this pair was specifically tested by MAPPIT or GPCA; a separate Methods section is not claimed from this selected cache.

PMID:32814053.scope: The neurodegeneration interaction screen supplies positive CNOT3 pairs with PECAM1, CALR, DLST, VCP and NEK7.
PMID:32814053.access: Complete authentic abstract and all fifteen exact positive two-hybrid records inspected. Participant roles and features are preserved; no native-tissue function or pair-specific orthogonal assay is inferred from the screen.

PMID:33961781.scope: BioPlex detects CNOT3 associations with CCR4–NOT subunits and TOB1 in tagged affinity-purification experiments.
PMID:33961781.access: Selected cache Introduction/Discussion assay-context text and twelve exact positive records inspected. This genuine cache is partial despite its full-text flag; uninspected target Results or Methods are not claimed.

PMID:40205054.scope: The original U2OS AP-MS network contains exact CNOT3 edges to CNOT1 and CNOT2.
PMID:40205054.access: Selected original Methods and Results plus the public target subnetwork were read. The recovered subnetwork contains CNOT6L but does not resolve the cited CNOT6 pair; this gap is not a claim of miscitation. Older independent CNOT6 experiments remain positive.

PMID:20133598.scope: Mouse Cnot3 localizes with NANOS2 and DCP1A in male-germ-cell P bodies.
PMID:20133598.access: Selected complete original Results and Methods read. RNase-resistant association and altered recruitment after Nanos2 loss support the compartment; endogenous human germ-cell localization is not asserted.

PMID:34210974.scope: Mouse Cnot3 supports asymmetric Dand5 mRNA decay in the embryonic node and laterality signaling.
PMID:34210974.access: Selected complete Results and Methods read. Mouse constructs expressed in HEK293T cells are kept distinct from human protein experiments; the developmental readouts are contextual consequences of the RNA-regulatory role.

PMID:31201375.scope: De novo CNOT3 variants associate with a variable neurodevelopmental disorder including developmental delay, intellectual disability and hypotonia.
PMID:31201375.access: Selected clinical Methods and Results read, including the 16-proband case series and explicit NM_014516.3 reference. Disease association does not establish a new molecular activity.

PMID:24121232.scope: CNOT2 and CNOT3 form a NOT-module heterodimer and make assembly contacts on CNOT1.
PMID:24121232.access: The selected normal cache is abstract-only. An authentic author-repository thesis contains the reproduced original article, whose selected Results, Discussion and Online Methods were independently read. Human biochemical assembly and Drosophila reporter rescue are distinct evidence scopes.

external_full_variant.scope: Original article reproduced in authentic author-repository thesis; selected PDF pages 149–151 and 153–154 contain Results, Discussion and Online Methods. Exact retrieval URL and page hashes are retained in the sealed bounded source receipt.

PMID:37653243.scope: Human CCR4–NOT recognizes stalled rabbit ribosomes through the N-terminal region of CNOT3.
PMID:37653243.access: Selected full Methods and Results read. The reconstituted system uses recombinant human proteins and rabbit reticulocyte ribosomes; the resolved CNOT3 region contacts rRNA, ribosomal proteins and P-site tRNA.

PMID:39571015.scope: Human CNOT3 recognizes P-site tRNA features and recruits CCR4–NOT in a codon-dependent mRNA-decay mechanism.
PMID:39571015.access: Selected complete human Methods and Results read, including HEK293T translation, cryo-EM, CNOT3/tRNA mutagenesis and decay reporters. This supports coordinated ribosome/tRNA recognition rather than a purified free-tRNA affinity measurement.

binding.scope: Literal positive records preserve each participant, method, feature and bait/prey or neutral role. Negative-interaction false means not negated; AP-MS/co-IP is not automatically a purified binary interface.

U2OS.unresolved: The retrieved target subnetwork does not establish the CNOT6 pair. This is not treated as proof of absence or miscitation. Independent older CNOT6 associations are retained.

propagation.scope: Current complete GOA and node-associated records are authenticated; historical PAINT topology/IBD placement is not reconstructed. Target self-inclusion and donor count are not adverse evidence.

GO:0005634.label: nucleus
GO:0005634.definition: A membrane-bounded organelle of eukaryotic cells in which chromosomes are housed and replicated. In most cells, the nucleus contains all of the cell's chromosomes except the organellar chromosomes, and is the site of RNA synthesis and processing. In some species, or in specialized cell types, RNA metabolism or DNA replication may be absent.

GO:0019899.label: enzyme binding
GO:0019899.definition: Binding to an enzyme, a protein with catalytic activity.

GO:0005737.label: cytoplasm
GO:0005737.definition: The contents of a cell excluding the plasma membrane and nucleus, but including other subcellular structures.

GO:0005829.label: cytosol
GO:0005829.definition: The part of the cytoplasm that does not contain organelles but which does contain other particulate matter, such as protein complexes.

GO:0030015.label: CCR4-NOT core complex
GO:0030015.definition: The core of the CCR4-NOT complex. In Saccharomyces the CCR4-NOT core complex comprises Ccr4p, Caf1p, Caf40p, Caf130p, Not1p, Not2p, Not3p, Not4p, and Not5p.

GO:0030014.label: CCR4-NOT complex
GO:0030014.definition: The Ccr4-Not complex is an eukaryotically conserved deadenylase that can initiate cytoplasmic mRNA decay, and reduce translation by releasing poly(A)-binding protein (Pab1/PABPC1). Ccr4-Not contains seven core subunits, including two poly(A)-specific exonucleases, Ccr4/CNOT6/CNOT6L and Caf1/Pop2/CNOT7/CNOT8.

GO:0006402.label: mRNA catabolic process
GO:0006402.definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of mRNA, messenger RNA, which is responsible for carrying the coded genetic 'message', transcribed from DNA, to sites of protein assembly at the ribosomes.

GO:0006355.label: regulation of DNA-templated transcription
GO:0006355.definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cellular DNA-templated transcription.

GO:2000036.label: regulation of stem cell population maintenance
GO:2000036.definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of stem cell population maintenance.

GO:0001829.label: trophectodermal cell differentiation
GO:0001829.definition: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of a trophectoderm cell.

GO:0000932.label: P-body
GO:0000932.definition: A focus in the cytoplasm where mRNAs may become inactivated by decapping or some other mechanism. Protein and RNA localized to these foci are involved in mRNA degradation, nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD), translational repression, and RNA-mediated gene silencing.

GO:0000289.label: nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening
GO:0000289.definition: Shortening of the poly(A) tail of a nuclear-transcribed mRNA from full length to an oligo(A) length.

GO:0120162.label: positive regulation of cold-induced thermogenesis
GO:0120162.definition: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cold-induced thermogenesis.

GO:0046982.label: protein heterodimerization activity
GO:0046982.definition: Binding to a nonidentical protein to form a heterodimer.

GO:0007368.label: determination of left/right symmetry
GO:0007368.definition: The establishment of an organism's body plan or part of an organism with respect to the left and right halves. The pattern can either be symmetric, such that the halves are mirror images, or asymmetric where the pattern deviates from this symmetry.

GO:0019901.label: protein kinase binding
GO:0019901.definition: Binding to a protein kinase, any enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a protein substrate.

GO:0051117.label: ATPase binding
GO:0051117.definition: Binding to an ATPase, any enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of ATP.

GO:0051087.label: protein-folding chaperone binding
GO:0051087.definition: Binding to a chaperone protein, a class of proteins that bind to nascent or unfolded polypeptides and ensure correct folding or transport.

GO:0180014.label: protein-tRNA adaptor activity
GO:0180014.definition: The binding activity of a protein that brings together another protein and a tRNA, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way.
